mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Syndra has achieved <spellName>Transcendence</spellName>, granting herself <scaleAP>@f1.0@ Ability Power</scaleAP>.

mBuff.mDescription:
Scatter the Weak
Syndra has deemed you weak, stunning you.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing {{Spell_SyndraQ_Damage_0}}. The Sphere remains for @spell.SyndraQ:SphereDuration@ seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

@spell.SyndraPassive:Q1UpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store @Upgrade1MaxAmmo@ charges of Dark Sphere.

Syndra generates a Dark Sphere charge every @AmmoRechargeTime@ seconds (reduced by Ability Haste).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability can be cast while moving.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit is marked by Syndra for collection.

mBuff.mDescription:
Transcendent
Syndra is assimilating power and has collected @f1@ Splinters of Wrath.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

@spell.SyndraPassive:EUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by @UpgradedSlowAmount*100@% for @UpgradedSlowDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: Enemies can only take damage and be Knocked Back from this Ability once per cast.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Syndra can collect up to @MaxStackAmount@ Splinters of Wrath. These enhance Syndra's Abilities and restore @ManaPerProc@ Mana each time she claims one from an enemy.

Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from the following:
  • @StacksPerProc@ Splinter(s) when damaging enemy champions with two Abilities within @MarkDuration@ seconds (@PassiveMarkCooldown@s Cooldown)
  • @PassiveStacksPerLevel@ Splinters upon spending Ability points
  • @StackPerSiege@ Splinter on killing large minions

    At @MaxStackAmount@ Splinters of Wrath, Syndra increases her Ability Power by @CapstoneAPPerc*100@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing {{Spell_SyndraQ_Damage_0}}. The Dark Sphere remains for @SphereDuration@ seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

@spell.SyndraPassive:Q1UpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store @Upgrade1MaxAmmo@ charges of Dark Sphere.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability can be cast while moving.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Dark Sphere gains an additional @QHastePerRank@ Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power.

Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage (max @MaxDamageCalc@ magic damage).

@spell.SyndraPassive:RUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability executes enemies below @UpgradeExecuteThreshold*100@% Health.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Force of Will</titleLeft><mainText>Syndra has a unit ready to throw.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds.

Recast: Syndra hurls the object, dealing {{Spell_SyndraW_Damage@f3@}} and Slowing by @TotalSlowAmount@% for @f2@ seconds.

@spell.SyndraPassive:WUpgradeThreshold@ Splinters of Wrath: This Ability deals an additional @TOOLTIPONLYPassiveBonusPercent@ true damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
If no target is selected, grabs nearest Dark Sphere.
This Ability can be cast while moving.
